verdict.rationale: Pipedream workflows let users pair event triggers (app events such as GitHub and Twitter, HTTP/webhook, schedule, email, RSS) with pre-built actions for thousands of apps or custom code. Automatic retries and error emails support unattended runs, and community users report hands-on use of event-driven auto-feeding pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a declarative conditional/filter rule builder (rule logic is only implied via custom code steps).
